issue.title: just lint is red on master: symvision reports progress_fingerprint unused
issue.description:
Discovered by epic sase-fa's land agent while running the static gates before closing the epic. NOT caused by sase-fa (which touched none of these files) and not tracked by any bead: it comes from master commit 840cdff10 'fix(commit-finalizer): break async-wait deadlock in finalizer passes' (SASE_PLAN=202608/finalizer_async_wait_deadlock.md, no SASE_BEAD footer), which landed 2026-08-05 18:03.

Reproduction at master 840cdff10 with a fresh 'just install':

    $ just lint
    ...
    Unused public functions/classes. Make these private if they are used only within the file they are defined...:
      progress_fingerprint in src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_git.py
    error: recipe `_lint-symvision` failed on line 273 with exit code 1
    error: recipe `lint` failed on line 248 with exit code 1

ruff and mypy (2749 files) both pass; symvision is the only failing gate, so every agent that runs 'just check' on master hits it.

The symbol is not actually dead: src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer.py calls it at lines 250 and 291, but through the module alias imported at line 16 ('from . import commit_finalizer_git as finalizer_git' -> 'finalizer_git.progress_fingerprint(dirty_state)'). Symvision resolves consumers through 'from X import name' bindings, so attribute access on a module alias does not count as a use.

Scope (mechanical): add progress_fingerprint to the existing 'from .commit_finalizer_git import (...)' list at src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer.py:25 and call it unqualified at both sites, which gives symvision a consumer it can see. Per sase/memory/symvision.md the alternatives are worse here: the symbol has a real cross-file consumer so it cannot be made private, and a pragma is only for consumers symvision cannot discover. Confirm with 'just symvision', then 'just check'.
